svg.title: Development-time candidate selection and held-out output evaluation
svg.desc: Two-stage scientific workflow. Development data are used to train and select predictor checkpoints with Validation-A, followed by Validation-B comparison of thirteen predefined trajectory candidates against Raw using a feasibility gate and ranking rule. Development choices are frozen before held-out Test evaluation. Output-level accuracy, geometry, boundary consistency, and local paired-error changes are characterized, followed by downstream application testing.
